DEICING PROCEDURE FOR ACFT ON MAIN-APRON AND GAC-APRON:
P R O C E D U R E:
1. REPORT THE NECESSITY FOR DEICING ASAP EITHER TO YOUR HANDLING
AGENT OR CONTACT YOUR CONTRACTED DEICING AGENT DIRECTLY.
ACFT WITHOUT CONTRACTED DEICING AGENT MAY CONTACT VIENNA ICE ON
131,630 MHZ OR TELEPHONE +431700722135.
2. INFORM ATC ON INITIAL CONTACT REGARDING NECESSITY FOR DEICING.
3. AREAS:
DE-ICING STANDBY AREA: PRKG PSNS E48 TO E99.
DE-ICING SOUTH: PRKG PSNS F43, F45, F47, F51, F53, F55, F57, F59
DE-ICING NORTH: PRKG PSNS F42, F44, F46, F48, F50
3.1 AREAS:
AIRBUS A380 AND ANTONOV 124 EXPECT PRKG PSN F55 FOR DEICING BOEING
B747-8 EXPECT PRKG PSNS F45, F46 OR F55 FOR DEICING
4. ACFT CLEARED TO THE DEICING STANDBY AREA APPROACH PRKG PSNS E48
TO E99 FROM THE SOUTH - MARSHALLER GUIDANCE ON THE AREA IS
MANDATORY. IF INSTRUCTED BY MARSHALLER CAR TO STOP ON THE DEICING
STANDBY AREA, DO NOT CUT ENGINES - INTERMEDIATE STOP ONLY.
THEREAFTER MARSHALLER GUIDANCE TO DEICING SOUTH IS PROVIDED AND
MANDATORY.
5. ACFT CLEARED TO DEICING NORTH VIA TL40 BLUE, TL40 ORANGE OR TL40
CENTER EXPECT MARSHALLER GUIDANCE ABM IHP BLUE1 OR ORANGE1.
6. MARSHALLER INSTRUCTIONS ARE ISSUED VIA DISPLAY ON FOLLOW ME CAR
OR BY HAND SIGNALS.
